2014_classes.artificer.egw.flavorText: Masters of invention, artificers use ingenuity and magic to unlock extraordinary capabilities in objects. They see magic as a complex system waiting to be decoded and then harnessed in their spells and inventions.
2014_classes.artificer.egw.magical-tinke: You've learned how to invest a spark of magic in objects that would otherwise be mundane. To use this ability, you must have thieves' tools, artisan's tools, or other special tools in hand. You then touch a Tiny nonmagical object as an action and give it one of the following magical properties: The object sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet. Whenever tapped by a creature, the object emits a recorded message that can be heard up to 10 feet away. You utter the message when you bestow this property on the object, and the recording can be no more than 6 seconds long. The object continuously emits your choice of an odor or a nonverbal sound (wind, waves, chirping, or the like). The chosen phenomenon is perceivable up to 10 feet away. A static visual effect appears on one of the object's surfaces. This effect can be a picture, up to 25 words of text, lines and shapes, or a mixture of these elements. The property lasts indefinitely. As an action, you can touch the object and end the property early. You can give the property to multiple objects, touching one object each time you use this feature, though a single object can only bear one property at a time. The maximum number of objects you can affect at one time is equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one object). If you try to exceed your maximum, the oldest property immediately ends, and then the new property applies.
[Active] (Action) Touch a Tiny nonmagical object to give it a magical property. Maximum objects affected equals Intelligence modifier.
You've studied the workings of magic and how to cast spells, channeling the magic through objects. You must have a spellcasting focus (thieves' tools or artisan's tools) in hand when you cast spells. You know 2 cantrips. You prepare spells equal to your Intelligence modifier + half your artificer level, rounded down (minimum of one spell).
[Active] (Action) Cast spells using thieves' tools or artisan's tools as focus. Know 2 cantrips, prepare Int mod + half level spells.
2014_classes.artificer.egw.infuse-item.d: You've gained the ability to imbue mundane items with certain magical infusions. When you gain this feature, pick 4 artificer infusions to learn. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch a nonmagical object and imbue it with one of your artificer infusions. You can infuse a number of items shown in the Infused Items column.
2014_classes.artificer.egw.infuse-item.s: [Active] Imbue mundane items with magical infusions. Learn 4 infusions, can infuse items equal to Infused Items column.
2014_classes.artificer.egw.right-tool-fo: You've learned how to produce exactly the tool you need: with thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand, you can magically create one set of artisan's tools in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. This creation requires 1 hour of uninterrupted work.
[Passive] With thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand, magically create one set of artisan's tools within 5 feet (1 hour).
2014_classes.artificer.egw.artificer-spe: You choose the type of specialist you are: Alchemist, Armorer, Artillerist, or Battle Smith. Your choice grants you features at 5th level and again at 9th and 15th level.
[Active] Choose specialist: Alchemist, Armorer, Artillerist, or Battle Smith. Grants features at 5th, 9th, 15th level.
2014_classes.artificer.egw.ability-score: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
[Passive] Increase one ability score by 2, or two by 1 (max 20). Granted at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, 19th level.
2014_classes.artificer.egw.artificer-spe: You gain a feature from your Artificer Specialist.
[Passive] Gain a feature from your Artificer Specialist.
2014_classes.artificer.egw.tool-expertis: Your proficiency bonus is now doubled for any ability check you make that uses your proficiency with a tool.
[Active] Proficiency bonus doubled for ability checks using tool proficiency.
2014_classes.artificer.egw.flash-of-geni: When you or another creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an ability check or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to the roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
[Active] (Reaction) Add Int modifier to ability check/save within 30 ft. Uses = Int mod (min 1), recharge long rest.
2014_classes.artificer.egw.magic-item-ad: You can attune to up to four magic items at once. If you craft a magic item with a rarity of common or uncommon, it takes you a quarter of the normal time, and it costs you half as much of the usual gold.
[Passive] Attune to up to 4 magic items. Craft common/uncommon items in 1/4 time at 1/2 cost.
2014_classes.artificer.egw.spell-storing: Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch one simple or martial weapon or one item that you can use as a spellcasting focus, and you store a spell in it, choosing a 1st- or 2nd-level spell from the artificer spell list that requires 1 action to cast. While holding the object, a creature can take an action to produce the spell's effect from it, using your spellcasting ability modifier. The spell stays in the object until it's been used a number of times equal to twice your Intelligence modifier (minimum of twice).
[Active] (Action) Store 1st/2nd level spell in weapon/focus after long rest. Usable 2x Int mod times.
2014_classes.artificer.egw.magic-item-sa: You can attune to up to five magic items at once. You ignore all class, race, spell and level requirements on attuning to or using a magic item.
[Passive] Attune to up to 5 magic items. Ignore all attunement requirements.
2014_classes.artificer.egw.magic-item-ma: You can attune to up to six magic items at once.
[Passive] Attune to up to 6 magic items.
2014_classes.artificer.egw.soul-of-artif: You have advantage on all saving throws. Additionally, you can use your reaction to end one of your artificer infusions, gaining a bonus to a saving throw you make. The bonus equals the number of items you have infused.
[Active] (Reaction) Advantage on all saves. End an infusion to add number of infused items to a saving throw.
